title: Run an eval: the overview
caption: Start a run through the site's API, follow it at its address, read its file, replay it for free, and record again when the replay says its recording is out of date.

cards.title: Run an eval
cards.text: An eval of a site's agent, run over the site's own API with the admin key.

cards.title: Start it
cards.text: Live with one repeat or three; it spends money on the agent's model and the judge's.

cards.title: Follow it
cards.text: Its address answers the run as it goes, and once it has ended.

cards.title: Read its file
cards.text: One JSON file per run in the data folder, the same record the API sends.

cards.title: Replay it
cards.text: The last live run played back from its recording, with no model called.
